name: pujan
description: Pu-Jan — 手牌5枚の麻雀ローグライト

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:prod -w backend && npm run tag:production
scripts.tag:production: node -e "const{execSync:x}=require('child_process');const t='production-'+new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g,'').slice(0,15);x('git tag -f production');x('git tag '+t);x('git push -f origin refs/tags/production refs/tags/'+t,{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && npm run deploy:dev -w backend
